onboarding.org.title: Register your organization
onboarding.org.body: BLUESKILLS reviews every organization before it can publish jobs or search talent.
onboarding.org.type: What kind of organization are you?
onboarding.org.type_hint.agency: You recruit for employers under a licence
onboarding.org.type_hint.institute: You train workers and certify skills
onboarding.org.registration_hint.employe: Trade licence or company registration number
onboarding.org.registration_hint.agency: Company registration number of the agency
onboarding.org.review_note: Next you will upload proof of registration. You can prepare your workspace while we review it.

onboarding.evidence.body: Our verification team checks each document before your organization is approved.
onboarding.evidence.no_review: There is no open review for this organization right now.
onboarding.evidence.next: You will see the decision in your workspace. Until then you can complete your profile and draft jobs.
organization.no_open_review: There is no open review to add documents to.
organization.verification_required: Your organization must be verified before you can do this.

organization.notice.rejected: Your verification was not approved. Check the reason and upload corrected documents.
organization.notice.suspended: Your organization is suspended. Contact BLUESKILLS support.

team.description: People who can work in this organization and what each of them can do.

team.role_not_allowed: That role is not available for this kind of organization.
team.already_member: This person is already a member.
team.last_owner: An organization needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.

team.pending_mine_body: Accept an invitation to join an organization that is already on BLUESKILLS.

team.mail.ignore: If you were not expecting it, you can ignore this email.

staff.deactivate_body: They will no longer be able to sign in. Their past actions stay in the audit log.
staff.email_taken: This email already belongs to a BLUESKILLS account.

auth.login.title: Sign in to BLUESKILLS
auth.login.body: For employers, agencies, training institutes and BLUESKILLS staff.
auth.login.worker_link: Looking for work? Sign in with your phone
auth.register.title: Create your account
auth.register.body: Start with your own details. You will add your organization next.
auth.register.email_hint: Use your work email if you have one. We will send a verification link.
auth.forgot.title: Reset your password
auth.forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.reset.title: Choose a new password
auth.reset.body: Use a long password you do not use anywhere else.
auth.verify_email.title: Check your email
auth.verify_email.body: Click the link we sent to verify your email address.
auth.verify_email.sent: We sent a new verification link to your email address.
auth.confirm.title: Confirm your password
auth.confirm.body: This is a secure area. Confirm your password to continue.

auth.two_factor.code_body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.two_factor.recovery_body: Enter one of your emergency recovery codes.
settings.profile.title: Profile
settings.profile.body: Update your name and email address.
settings.profile.body_worker: Update your name. Your phone number is your sign-in.
settings.profile.unverified: Your email address is not verified yet.
settings.password.title: Change password
settings.password.body: Use a long, random password to keep your account safe.
settings.appearance.title: Appearance
settings.appearance.body: Choose light, dark or match your device.
settings.delete.title: Delete account
settings.delete.body: Delete your account and the data in it.
settings.delete.cannot_undo: You will not be able to sign in again with this account.
settings.delete.confirm_body: Enter your password to confirm. Records needed for audit and legal reasons are kept as the law requires.
settings.two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
settings.two_factor.body: Ask for a code from your phone each time you sign in.
settings.two_factor.enabled_body: On. You will enter a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
settings.two_factor.disabled_body: Off. Turn it on to protect your account with a code from an authenticator app.

settings.two_factor.error_key: We could not load the setup key. Reload the page and try again.
settings.two_factor.error_codes: We could not load your recovery codes. Reload the page and try again.
settings.recovery.title: Recovery codes
settings.recovery.body: Use these if you lose your phone. Store them in a password manager.
settings.recovery.note: Each code works once. Make new codes when you run low.
settings.passkeys.title: Passkeys
settings.passkeys.body: Sign in with your device instead of a password.
settings.passkeys.none_body: Add a passkey to sign in without a password.
settings.passkeys.remove_body: You will no longer be able to sign in with ":name".
settings.passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
settings.passkeys.name: Passkey name
settings.passkeys.name_hint: A name helps you recognise this passkey later.
